name: FOUP placement sensor misaligned
description: Placement sensor shifted after maintenance and does not confirm the FOUP

name: Mapping sensor contaminated
description: Residue on the mapping sensor causes false slot readings

name: Robot servo amplifier fault
description: Servo amplifier output unstable under load

name: Robot teaching position offset
description: End-effector position drifted from taught coordinates

name: End-effector vacuum pad worn
description: Worn vacuum pad cannot seal against the wafer backside

name: Spin chuck pin wear
description: Worn chuck pins no longer centre and hold the wafer

name: Flow meter calibration drift
description: Measured flow deviates from actual flow

name: Chemical filter clogged
description: Clogged filter raises pressure drop, restricts flow and can shed particles

name: Recipe parameter overwritten after software update
description: Update reset a recipe value to its default

name: Heater thermocouple failure
description: Thermocouple reads wrongly so the heater over- or under-shoots

name: Suck-back valve setting incorrect
description: Suck-back too weak to stop residual liquid at the nozzle

name: Exhaust damper stuck
description: Damper does not open fully, reducing exhaust

name: Megasonic generator output degraded
description: Lower megasonic power reduces particle removal

name: Host communication configuration error
description: SECS/GEM settings or recipe naming do not match the fab host

name: Bath concentration sensor drift
description: Sensor drift leads to wrong chemical make-up

name: Anode wear
description: Worn or passivated anode gives uneven current distribution

name: Rectifier output board fault
description: Rectifier board delivers unstable plating current

name: Chamber lid O-ring degraded
description: Aged O-ring no longer seals the chamber lid

name: Drain line fitting loose
description: Loose fitting lets chemical escape at the drain line

name: Gripper actuator spring fatigue
description: Fatigued spring keeps the gripper from opening fully

name: Spin motor encoder fault
description: Encoder signal error makes speed control unstable

name: Fab facility supply out of spec
description: Facility exhaust capacity or DIW quality below requirement

name: Controller software version mismatch
description: Controller and host interface versions are incompatible

name: N2/IPA dry nozzle flow unstable
description: Unstable N2 or IPA flow at the dry step leaves droplets that dry into watermarks

name: Chemical crystal build-up at nozzle or chamber wall
description: Splash and mist residue (e.g. from hot SPM) dries into crystals that fall back as particles

name: Filter not fully primed after replacement
description: Gas left in a new filter releases micro-bubbles and particles in the first runs

name: Robot vacuum line restricted or kinked
description: Debris or a pinched line keeps the end-effector from reaching vacuum

name: Robot cable wear from repeated flexing
description: Broken conductors in the moving cable cause intermittent encoder signals

name: Heater element degraded
description: Heater cannot hold the bath or inline set-point

name: Chemical pump diaphragm worn
description: Worn diaphragm lowers delivery pressure and can leak chemical

name: Chemical replenishment valve stuck
description: Spiking or make-up valve does not open, so concentration or level drifts

name: IPA vapor supply unstable
description: IPA vapor concentration near the meniscus fluctuates during Marangoni drying

name: Wafer carrier guide wear
description: Worn carrier guides add contact points that generate particles

name: Quick dump rinse valve leaking
description: Leaking dump valve stops the tank from refilling and rinsing fully

name: Plating bath additive concentration out of range
description: Accelerator, suppressor or leveler drifts from target, affecting thickness and fill

name: Contact ring plating residue
description: Metal redeposited on contacts raises contact resistance unevenly around the edge

name: Lip seal worn or damaged
description: Electrolyte or rinsate wicks past the seal to the wafer edge and contacts

name: Equipment network cable or switch fault
description: Intermittent link between tool and host drops HSMS messages

name: Load port door or clamp mechanism misadjusted
description: FOUP is not clamped or the door cannot unlatch

name: Wafer cross-slotted or protruding in FOUP
description: Incoming wafer position in the FOUP is abnormal
